snippet.description:
Lagrange multipliers method solved examples for maxima and minima with constraints in calculus. Learn Lagrange's method of undetermined multipliers for B.Sc Maths, Engineering Mathematics & GATE.

Iss lecture mein hum discuss karenge Lagrange's Method of Undetermined Multipliers (लैंग्राज की अनिर्धारित गुणांक विधि). Jab hume kisi multivariable function ka maximum ya minimum value find karna ho with given conditions ya constraints (प्रतिबंध), tab hum Lagrange multiplier method ka use kaise karte hain, ye step-by-step detail mein samjhaya gaya hai.

Video highlights:
- Introduction to Constrained Optimization (सप्रतिबंध उच्चिष्ठ एवं निम्निष्ठ)
- Concept of Lagrange's Function and Multiplier (λ)
- Step-by-step algorithm to find stationary points
- University exams aur entrance level ke important solved examples

00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Maxima and Minima
01:25 - Concept of Constrained Optimization
02:02 - Lagrange Multipliers Method & Auxiliary Function
07:11 - Example 1: Minimize x + y + z subject to a/x + b/y + c/z = 1
12:30 - Second Order Condition (d²L) for Example 1
17:00 - Example 2: Minimum Value of x² + y² + z² with Linear Constraint
23:07 - Example 3: Stationary Values of ax² + by² + cz²
28:30 - Example 4: Maxima & Minima using Determinant Condition
40:51 - Example 5: Optimization with Two Constraints (λ and μ)
49:06 - Summary & Introduction to Integral Calculus (Beta & Gamma Functions)

Agar aapko kisi bhi step me doubt ho toh comment karke zaroor poochiye. Video ko like karein, share karein aur channel ko subscribe karna na bhulein!

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Maxima and Minima of Two Variables: Concept & Solved Examples  → https://youtu.be/PIrJj0dVYT0

📺 Complete Playlist:

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Happy Learning! 📐✨
